title: Figure Spec Bundle
description: ANALYZE-stage artifact. Output of figure-generator. A machine-readable bundle of figure specifications — NOT rendered images. Each figure spec describes what to plot (data source, axes, type, labels) so a downstream renderer or human can produce the actual figure. figures[] minItems 1 ensures at least one spec is present.

run_ref.description: Reference to the run/result_summary this bundle is based on

figure_id.description: Unique identifier for this figure spec, e.g. fig1_dice_comparison

data_source.description: Reference to the result_summary, run_record, or condition_id this figure visualizes

y_axis.description: Y-axis specification including optional min/max range

conditions.description: Which condition_ids are included in this figure

notes.description: Any additional notes for the renderer

figures.description: List of figure specifications. minItems 1 ensures at least one is present.
